description: Read the durable datasets, stable semantic element IDs, and view bindings from one completed analysis run in the current conversation. Use this before resolving any chart-derived value or condition. The response exposes schemas, stable IDs, and derivations, not full row dumps. For a follow-up chart edit, request includeProgram=true to retrieve the exact saved code and revision linkage. Set displaySavedChart=true to reopen the unchanged saved chart inline without a new program, broker read or runtime execution. It retains its original data timestamps; it does not refresh prices. Each dataset has an inputId for internal_data.get. Reuse full calculation history for the same source and period; fetch missing periods or refreshed data when needed. This tool is generic and does not infer behavior from indicator names, labels, or user wording.

displaySavedChart.description: Reopen the original saved chart without recomputing or refreshing data. Returns its original result and observation timestamps.

includeProgram.description: Return the original code, capabilities and revision linkage for a chart edit. Omit for dataset or semantic inspection.

name: inspect_analysis_artifact
title: Inspect reusable analysis data and semantic elements
